title: Faction
description: A faction from the factions module (docs/modules/factions.md). Reputation is one integer per faction on the actor. Standing and rank are functions of it; their effects are contract modifiers. Referenced as module:factions/faction/<key>.

standingModifier.description: A contract modifier emitted while this standing holds. Every standing of one faction uses source faction_standing:<faction key>, so a new standing replaces the old bundle.

rankModifier.description: A contract modifier emitted while this rank is held and not suspended. Every rank of one faction uses source faction_rank:<faction key>.

standing.description: A named reputation band. The standing is the last row whose min_reputation <= reputation.

min_reputation.description: Inclusive lower bound. The first row equals the faction's reputation_min.

rank.description: A membership rank, lowest first. Held by event; suspended (no modifiers) while reputation is below min_reputation.

min_reputation.description: Reputation needed to be promoted to, and to keep the benefits of, this rank.

modifiers.description: The whole bundle for this rank. Ranks do not accumulate.

relation.description: A one-hop spillover. A change of delta here changes the related faction by trunc(delta * share_percent / 100), toward zero.

reputationEvent.description: A default reputation delta a consumer may emit for this faction.

reputation_start.description: Reputation of an actor with no entry for this faction.
